GEDER Truth Gate Pipeline 1.0.0 - Build report

Validated with:
  gcc -std=c89 -pedantic -Wall -Wextra

Targets compiled:
  npc_perception_demo
  incremental_demo
  test_geder_truth_gate

Test result:
  GEDER Truth Gate Pipeline: all tests passed.

Behavior validated:
  - CONTINUE accumulates truth count, fixed-point score and truth mask.
  - ACCEPT stops the chain immediately with an accepted final result.
  - REJECT stops the chain immediately with a rejected final result.
  - Disabled gates are skipped.
  - End-of-chain threshold policies work.
  - Incremental execution evaluates at most one enabled gate per step.
  - Fixed-point conversion and saturating addition helpers pass tests.
